author: Warhammer
description:
Nurgle's corruption knows no bounds, infecting all aspects of his followers, including their armour! In this video, Dan shows just how decayed it can get. 

Watch along and find out how to get your followers looking their dirtiest.

Here’s a list of the paints we used in today’s video:

Contrast:
Creed Camo
Gutrippa Flesh
Nazdreg Yellow
Snakebite Leather

Base:
Ionrach Skin
Leadbelcher
Wraithbone

Layer:
Gorthor Brown
Ironbreaker
Skrag Brown 
Tau Light Ochre

Shade:
Agrax Earthshade

Technical:
Lahmian Medium

Tools:
Small Base Brush STC
Small Layer Brush STC

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.
